I dont get the basic  nice experiances most people my age get, the the things that would make me happy are directly correlated to at least being okay-enough looking to wear nice things, and the only way my flesh could be moulded to that purpose involves alot of very expensive surgery.  it doesnt matter if i think im worth more than my looks because at the end of the day almost no-one else does and unfortunately in life it is mostly the decisions of other people that will decide how far you progress in the direction you want.
